headline: Luxury Cruise Passengers Stranded in Cambodia Amid High Fuel Costs
summary: The Villa Vie Odyssey suspended its voyage and arranged temporary living arrangements for stranded passengers due to surging global fuel costs.
why: Escalating maritime fuel expenses directly impact operating margins for commercial passenger liners and long-distance travel providers.

impacts.name: Tourism
impacts.why: High bunker fuel prices squeeze operational viability for cruise operators, risking stranded itineraries and refund liabilities.
